title: Propagate cleanup-unknown when the federation stderr diagnostic thread cannot start
outcome: A failure to start the stderr diagnostic reader does not hide an unresolved cleanup of the already spawned owned SSH child or admit an overlapping retry.
acceptance: On diagnostic-reader thread spawn failure after child spawn, the existing process owner explicitly reaps the child before returning; a reap failure propagates FederationSshCleanupUnknown to the existing runtime quarantine path.

A deterministic failure regression distinguishes successful cleanup from unresolved cleanup without live SSH, preserving exact child ownership, reap-before-replace and existing material, credential and quarantine fences.
